Anthropic is a hybrid research, product, and platform company: it develops AI systems and commercializes them through Claude products and developer-facing access.

Its dominant commercial motion is increasingly enterprise and ecosystem enabled rather than services-led. Anthropic supplies the core AI product and platform; cloud, technology, and services partners expand reach, implementation capacity,

The central tension is between fast ecosystem scale and controlled customer outcomes. Partners must be empowered to build and deploy independently while remaining aligned to Anthropic’s product capabilities, technical guidance, and
responsible-AI positioning.
